source: Golden Theme variant tournament against the reach-recovery brief and Layer E story-selling card.
selector_verdict: Winner starts from a public couple truth, proves it with concrete Aachu/Nancho behavior, makes Zuv/Himanshu actively complicit, and keeps the money as a tiny proof object rather than the premise.
calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the gold carousel machine: universal anti-ideal -> expressive Aachu proof -> Zuv's calm active joining -> tender acceptance thesis.
final_public_slide_copy_direction: Some wives don't ask. They audit wallets.
He saw and still joined the bit.
Love is when your nonsense has a budget.

candidates.name: Wallet Audit Love
candidates.universal_truth: The best couples do not only tolerate each other's nonsense; they quietly budget for it.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu/Nancho treats a tiny wallet raid like household finance ministry work.
candidates.concrete_proof: Bas 500, the backup pocket, the caught-but-not-stopped moment, and the extra cash by morning.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv/Himanshu sees everything, pretends to sleep, points to the backup pocket, and prepares for her next bit.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is when your nonsense has a budget.

candidates.name: Finance Minister At Home
candidates.universal_truth: Every couple has one finance minister and one person pretending not to notice.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu/Nancho audits pockets with affectionate authority.
candidates.concrete_proof: One note becomes a backup-pocket inspection.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv/Himanshu turns the audit into a shared ritual by enabling it without speeches.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love makes room for tiny household nonsense.

candidates.name: He Pretended To Sleep
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes love is not stopping the bit; it is joining quietly.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu/Nancho thinks the wallet moment is hers, but her expression gives the whole game away.
candidates.concrete_proof: Zuv/Himanshu opens one eye, closes it again, and points to the pocket.
candidates.zuv_role: He chooses fond complicity over correction.
